info.title: Matching Man API
info.description:
Multi-tenant matchmaking platform API.

Game servers authenticate with a project API key (`projectApiKey`) issued via `POST /v1/projects/:projectId/api-keys`.
The admin dashboard authenticates with a per-user session token from `/v1/auth/login` or `/v1/auth/register`, or the break-glass `DASHBOARD_ADMIN_TOKEN` (`sessionToken`).

sessionToken.description: Dashboard session token or admin token, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`.

organizationName.description: Personal organization created for this user.

email.description: The invitee must already be registered.

enableDodgePenalty.description: Whether queue dodgers and AFK players receive temporary lockouts.

penaltyTiers.description: Array of penalty durations in seconds by violation tier.

email.description: The invitee must already be registered.

requiredSlots.description: Total player slots across the match.

groupCount.description: Number of opposing groups (e.g. 2 for teams A/B).

initialRatingWindow.description: Initial rating band width for candidate matching.

windowExpandIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between each rating window expansion.

enableReadyCheck.description: Whether matches require an accept/decline ready check handshake.

readyCheckTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds players have to accept a match.

winnerGroupIndex.description: Index of the winning group; omit for a draw.

claimantTeamId.description: The ID of the team filing the dispute.

reason.example: Player was using unauthorized third-party software during the match.
reason.description: Detailed reason for the dispute (maximum 500 characters).

evidence.description: Optional metadata or evidence supporting the dispute claim.

overrideWinnerGroupIndex.description: The winning group index override (1-based), or omit/null to declare a draw/void.

resolutionNotes.example: Reviewed match replay clip. Player in team 1 was using prohibited client modifications.
resolutionNotes.description: Mandatory operator resolution notes explaining the rationale for the resolution.

resolutionNotes.example: Insufficient evidence provided. Replay shows legitimate game behavior.
resolutionNotes.description: Mandatory operator resolution notes explaining the rationale for rejecting the dispute.
